tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Amidah: You are One and Your Name is One,

tei:availability.tei:p: Published by Sefaria under CC-BY, which Sefaria defines as Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

tei:div.tei:p:
You are One and Your Name is One,
and who is like Your people Israel a unique nation on earth. The glory of greatness, and the crown of deliverance— a day of rest and holiness— have You given Your people. Abraham exults, Isaac sings joyously, Jacob and his sons rest thereon— a rest of love and free will, a rest of truth and faith(fulness), a rest of peace and tranquility, and of serenity and security, —a perfect rest with which you are pleased. Your children will realize and know that from You does their rest come, and through their rest, they sanctify Your Name.

tei:note.tei:p: Our Sages relate that the patriarchs observed the Sabbath and fulfilled all its precepts. The other children of Abraham and Isaac are not mentioned in the prayer because Ishmael, the children of Keturah, and Esau were not commanded to observe the Sabbath. Etz Yosef and Iyun Tefilah comment that both Abraham and Isaac lived more tranquil and fulfilled lives than Jacob. Thus it is said that Abraham exults and Isaac is joyous, but in reference to Jacob, there is no mention of joy or exultation, merely that he rested.
This is not only a rest from daily toil but a voluntary desisting from work to manifest love of God. Iyun Tefiloh.
It is a rest dedicated to the pursuit of truth and faithfulness, through Torah-study.
